transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 862 Echo Canyon Drive?
Yes, this is 862 Echo Canyon Drive. Three people here, water’s inside. Need help.
Acknowledged, water’s inside at 862 Echo Canyon Drive. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Three people total. Everyone can come to the phone.

Thanks for letting us know everyone can come to the phone. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one can’t leave alone. No wheelchairs or oxygen here.
Understood, no one is unable to leave alone. Is there water inside the home right now?
Yes, water is inside. We’re three people, no help coming.
I heard you, three people, water inside, no help coming. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No truck, no boat, no seats. We’re stuck inside.
I hear you’re stuck inside right now. Let me read that back: 3 people; water is inside. Is that right?
Yes. Water’s inside. Three people here. Can’t leave.

Acknowledged, three people inside with water. I've recorded that you need help leaving. No responder has been assigned yet. If water is rising inside, move to the highest floor and call 911 if you can get through. Goodbye.

house_card: Three people can't leave alone; water inside. English.
